title: "rungar validate"
description: "Check a configuration file, without contacting GitHub or any provider"
---

Check a configuration file as the daemon would load it: every key, the providers' parts and every scale set's runner block, and the files it names -- the GitHub credential and each provider's own. Nothing is contacted and no daemon is needed, so it can be run anywhere the files are. It exits non-zero if the daemon would not start from the file.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar validate [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-f`, `--config string` | Configuration file. Default: `/etc/rungar/config.yaml`. |
